post.label: storage
post.why: GOD is the writable layer. Without a local store there is nowhere to write.

post.label: network
post.why: DOG is fetched over HTTP. Without fetch there is no root filesystem.

post.label: crypto
post.why: Used to derive this device's stable machine id. Falls back to a random id.

post.label: workers
post.why: Not required to boot. Reported so you know what this machine can do.

post.label: display
post.why: There has to be somewhere to draw the console.
